svg.text: 10,000 sf Office - Central AHU with VAV / Fan-Powered Boxes (perimeter offices, rev 2)
Ceiling plan at 9 ft AFF looking up, north is up. Ductwork centreline 11 ft 6 in AFF. Grid 25 ft. Scale 1 ft = 7 px.
Square with X = 24x24 supply diffuser. Square with bar = 24x24 plenum return grille.
AHU-1 10,000 cfm, 1,800 cfm OA. Primary air 8,830 cfm: 4 VAV + 12 FPB. 44 diffusers, 36 return grilles, 934.5 ft duct. Denver exposure factors: S 1.5, W 1.35, E 1.25, N 1.0.
